description: A narrow, rectilinear linear feature trending roughly north–south visible as a subtle concave depression flanked by low embankments. The feature is between 3–6 m wide, extends for approximately 1.2 km in the tile, and shows up as a darker band in the NIR composite (moisture‐retaining “dark earth”) and as an incised line in the LiDAR hillshade.

A short east–west–oriented linear segment, ~80 m long and 4 m wide, cutting across a gentle saddle. It appears as a raised berm in the DTM curvature derivative and is accompanied by a coincident low‐NIR strip suggestive of an old drainage ditch feeding the main north–south canal.
